notes.title: 🎥 New Official Trailer LIVE + Dev Update
notes.notes:

🚨 The brand new official trailer is here! If you haven't watched it yet, now is as good a time as any. You're getting your first clear eyed look at chaos, swinging, and velocity we've constructed.


[previewyoutube="D1Mf78s8Vy0;full"][/previewyoutube]

 Full momentum mode is on! polishing, playtesting, and injecting energy in every frame. Take a glimpse of what's being worked on at our workbench right now:

Even juicier, smoother momentum-based movement

Punchier image and effect impacts

Vibrant new isometric style pixel art environment props



🛡️ Closed Beta is Closer Than Ever!
 We're setting up a closed beta, and we need YOU in our swing team.

If you're willing to grab early builds, squash issues, and contribute towards finalizing the final gameplay loop, register yourself and be among the first people entering the swing zone.

 Your input has already propelled this game further than we ever thought it would go, and we'd love to get you closer to the dev process. Swing into our Discord to:

Share your top favorite scenes of your trailer

Hype wild new pole mechanics or power-ups

Register as a beta tester now

Help us fine-tune the momentum feel to perfection



🫶 Thanks for Being Awesome 

 Each wishlist, comment, and swing clip matters to us. You're not just along for the ride, you're in it.

Let’s make Momento Pole the most exhilarating roguelite out there, together.

Catch you in the swing zone,


– Throne Crow Team

notes.title: Official Trailer Now Live & Development Update – We Need Your Feedback!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🌟

A little while back we sneakily dropped our Momento Pole trailer on Steam, and now we’re excited to officially shout it from the rooftops! 🎥✨ If you haven’t seen it yet, head over and give it a watch—it’s your first look at all the swinging, momentum-fueled chaos we’ve been cooking up.

👉 Catch the trailer here:
[previewyoutube=wcqsYczM7w4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

---

🚀 Full Speed Ahead on Development

We’re barreling through development at full throttle—fine-tuning mechanics, polishing visuals, and making sure each swing feels as awesome as it looks. Here’s what’s on our workbench right now:

- New Pole Types & Abilities: Experimenting with electrified poles, gravity-shifting hooks, and more surprises.
- Balancing & QoL: Tighter controls, improved audio cues, and smoother UI flows.
- Art & Effects: Extra particle flourishes, refined animations, and pixel art polish on every corner.

---

🛡️ Closed Beta Testing Ahead!

We’re gearing up for closed beta tests very soon, and we’d love your help to make Momento Pole rock-solid. If you’ve got a bit of time and want to dive into early builds, help us squash bugs, and shape the final gameplay loop, join our beta crew!

💡 Why join?
- Get exclusive access to early builds
- Direct line to the dev team for feedback
- Special Discord role & in-game badge for beta testers

---

💬 Join Our Discord & Shape the Game!

Your feedback has been invaluable so far, and we want to bring you even closer to the process. Swing by our Discord to:

1. Share your favorite trailer moment
2. Pitch new pole mechanics or power-ups
3. Sign up for closed beta testing
4. Help us tweak the swing feel for max momentum fun

👋 Hop into our community:
Discord

Inside you’ll find sneak peeks of in-progress builds, beta sign-up details, dev polls, behind-the-scenes chats, and fellow momentum maniacs.

---

Thank you for your amazing support—every wishlist, comment, and crazy swing clip keeps us charging ahead. Let’s make Momento Pole the most exhilarating roguelite out there… together! 💪🔥

See you in the swing zone,

— The ThroneCrowStudios Team
